title: RoVeR23c
description: This is a smp server with more mob varients, spawn animations, round trees, and more with support for Vivecraft VR and Simple Voicechat.
body:
RoVeR23c is a SMP with some cool features like custom resource packs, tool trims, craftable name tags, craftable enchanted apples, craftable spawn eggs, and more.
Has Simple Voicechat Support!
Has Jade and REI Support!
Has Custom Player Models Support!
Has Emotecraft Support!
Has Vivecraft Support!
Has No Chat Reports!
Has Voice Messeges Support!
Has Voicechat Interaction Support!
Java: 1.7.2-26.1.2 Bedrock: 1.21.130-26.21

Java IP: impact-halifax.gl.joinmc.link Java Port: 26666

Bedrock IP: wham-unless.gl.at.ply.gg Bedrock Port: 3092

If using QuestCraft please use the latest version for 1.20.1.



Visual issues for some features while on Bedrock.


Has FGM Server Side Support.
